        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Form</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Insurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Photo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Means</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Evidence</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Join2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Type</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_SubmitAT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_SubmitForeign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Merge1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Provide</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Enter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TIMER_Wait</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_LORD" name="Landlord">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Accommodation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_BANK" name="Bank">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Bank</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_AUT" name="Austrian authorities (representation office, state police headquarters)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_CheckComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Request</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Decide</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Issue</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Refuse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END_Refused</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Extend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Extend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END_Stay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="START" name="Decide to work and live in Austria" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Check" name="Check requirements for working and living in Austria" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_Fork1" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Accommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Bank" name="Open bank account" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_Join1" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_Fork2" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Form" name="Fill in visa application form" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Insurance" name="Obtain travel health insurance (30,000 EUR, valid in Schengen area)" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Photo" name="Obtain passport photo (35 x 45 mm)" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Means" name="Prove sufficient means of subsistence" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Evidence" name="Collect other evidence (hotel reservations, invitations, return flight ticket, proof of employment)" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_Join2" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Type" name="Type D visa?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_SubmitAT" name="Submit application at Austrian representation office at place of residence" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_SubmitForeign" name="Submit application at representation office of main travel destination" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Merge1" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_CheckComplete" name="Check application completeness" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Complete" name="Application complete?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Request" name="Request additional documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Provide" name="Provide additional documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_Decide" name="Decide on visa application" />

    <bpmn:task id="T_Refuse" name="Notify refusal" />

    <bpmn:task id="T_Enter" name="Enter Austria and take up residence" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="TIMER_Wait" name="Wait x months">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P6M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="T_Extend" name="Extend visa (Rot-Weiss-Rot Card)" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Extend" name="Extension permitted?" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END_Stay" name="Stay ends" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F01" sourceRef="START" targetRef="T_Check" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="GW_Fork2" targetRef="T_Means" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="GW_Fork2" targetRef="T_Evidence" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" sourceRef="T_Form" targetRef="GW_Join2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" sourceRef="T_Insurance" targetRef="GW_Join2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F15" sourceRef="T_Photo" targetRef="GW_Join2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F16" sourceRef="T_Means" targetRef="GW_Join2" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F18" sourceRef="GW_Join2" targetRef="GW_Type" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F19" name="yes" sourceRef="GW_Type" targetRef="T_SubmitAT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F20" name="no" sourceRef="GW_Type" targetRef="T_SubmitForeign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F21" sourceRef="T_SubmitAT" targetRef="GW_Merge1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F22" sourceRef="T_SubmitForeign" targetRef="GW_Merge1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F23" sourceRef="GW_Merge1" targetRef="T_CheckComplete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F24" sourceRef="T_CheckComplete" targetRef="GW_Complete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F25" name="no" sourceRef="GW_Complete" targetRef="T_Request" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F29" sourceRef="T_Decide" targetRef="GW_Decision" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F38" name="no" sourceRef="GW_Extend" targetRef="END_Stay" />
